limitations: Legacy vortex and pipette task predicates remain distinct from the independent assessments.
The source pipette robot recipe validates aspiration only; destination dispense is covered by geometry integration tests.
Ideal volume accounting does not validate calibrated fluid performance.
Composite centrifuge regression covers insertion, not lid closure or spin.
Vortex Isaac no-action control covers 2 seconds; source controls cover 30 seconds.
Cylinder approximation is a separately recorded diagnostic, not the default collision setting.
Wall times include startup and logging on a shared server; performance parity is unqualified.

source_pipette_refinement_comparison.scope: Pipette descent reads the measured liquid height; surface refinement changes the descent target. These are recorded differences, not a claim of identical mechanics.
